# Native local-algebra spatial control

**Type:** bounded_theorem

This note preserves the complete frozen independent native interval-algebra
proof. It estimates correlations and distant ground response on entire even
norm unit balls of finite native intervals, with no polynomial-resource or
physical probe-length bound. Its interval geometry, supplied actual dynamics,
fixed upper spacing and small total bounded even interaction remain hypotheses.
The constants are the sufficient constants of A5-A7; they are not optimized.

The signed native coefficient generator and even-spin realization are supplied
by the exact [Concrete](CONCRETE_GAPPED_CHAIN_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md),
[Current](CURRENT_PRESERVING_REFINEMENT_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md)
and [Local](LOCAL_EVEN_CONTINUUM_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md)
parents. The actual common-domain ground premise comes from
[bounded interaction and ground selection](BOUNDED_INTERACTION_GROUND_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md).
The [continuum/local-ground companion](CONTINUUM_LOCAL_GROUND_SPATIAL_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md)
preserves the earlier local-ground parent and its controls. The native proof
reconstructs the propagation, ground differentiation and finite-measure filters;
it does not infer them from favorable review labels.

Current remains an open_gate with conditional-support surface status. All
these parent uses remain conditional and provisional; no transitive audit or
retained authority is supplied. The following original body, including its
historical status and exposure wording, is unchanged.

# Continuum clustering and distant ground response

**Type:** bounded_theorem

This note places two complete frozen arguments side by side. The first
proves continuum ground clustering using the distance that permits passage
inside the bounded defect interval. The second proves distant ground response,
including a norm-unit-ball continuum local-algebra bound and the older
polynomial-resource native bound. The G and L equation labels refer to their
respective unchanged source parts.

The exact physical model and coefficient support conventions are supplied by
[Concrete](CONCRETE_GAPPED_CHAIN_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md),
[Current](CURRENT_PRESERVING_REFINEMENT_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md)
and [Local](LOCAL_EVEN_CONTINUUM_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md).
The common-domain bounded perturbation and ground selection are supplied by
the [bounded-ground parent](BOUNDED_INTERACTION_GROUND_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md).
Current remains an open_gate; these sources remain conditional-support
premises. No full-Fock statement is assigned the even-complement gap, and
no local type-I tensor factor or trace compactness is presumed.

Both proofs use finite complex spectral measures for bounded even probes,
including rough compact L2 fields and norm-closed local-algebra elements.
They require no positive excitation moment of the inserted vectors.
Coupling interpolation is not physical preparation time. All source status,
review and exposure text below is preserved literally.

# Near-ground spatial correlation control

**Type:** bounded_theorem

The complete frozen argument below controls connected correlations by actual
excess form energy above the selected gapped ground. It includes the explicit
coherent four-particle free-continuum family that prevents the stated uniform
improvement beyond square-root dependence, the linear alternative under ground-block diagonality,
and clustering for each fixed normal free state with fixed translated probes.
These are different quantifiers, retained without alteration.

The exact [Concrete](CONCRETE_GAPPED_CHAIN_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md),
[Current](CURRENT_PRESERVING_REFINEMENT_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md),
[Local](LOCAL_EVEN_CONTINUUM_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md)
and [bounded-ground](BOUNDED_INTERACTION_GROUND_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md)
parents retain their supplied model and representation status; Current is
still an open_gate. The [continuum spatial companion](CONTINUUM_LOCAL_GROUND_SPATIAL_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md)
contains the exact ground-clustering input. The archived comparison's
specified protocol substitutions have the separately conditional
[preparation](ADIABATIC_GROUND_PREPARATION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md)
and [response/pulse](EXCITATION_PULSE_RESPONSE_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-12.md)
parents. Those protocol inputs are not required for the general state-energy
inequality or its coherent state-family counterexample.

Even support of a density, parity invariance and evenness of a probe are
distinct conditions. The stronger even gap in the state error requires
even-sector support. Arbitrary autonomous holds preserve the actual excess;
this does not supply an unrestricted long-time continuum operator comparison.
